question: The set of all real numbers \(x\) satisfying the inequality \(|x^2+3x|+x^2-2\ge0\) is

options.A: all the real numbers \(x\) with either \(x\le-3\) or \(x\ge2\)
options.B: all the real numbers \(x\) with either \(x\le-3\) or \(x\ge\frac12\)
options.C: all the real numbers \(x\) with either \(x\le-2\) or \(x\ge\frac12\)
options.D: described by none of the foregoing statements

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
